headline: Braskem Details Related-Party Gas Transactions Totaling R$ 51.3 Million
summary: Braskem S.A. detailed gas business operations between Voqen and Petrobras totaling R$ 51.3 million, classified as related-party transactions.
why: Braskem is a major petrochemical company, and Petrobras is a primary state-controlled energy producer in Brazil, making operational and supply disclosures relevant to their financial governance.

impacts.name: Braskem S.A.
impacts.why: Disclosure of related-party transactions provides transparency on internal business dealings.
